subject: MSA redlines + evidence handoff: questionnaire, SOC2 artifacts, pen-test access
content:
From: Eli Navarro <eli.navarro@medivault.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Qureshi <samira.qureshi@medivault.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MSA / order form follow-up: SOC 2 artifacts + pen-test access

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for walking us through Redwood last week. Legal and security had a few follow-ups as we prepare the order form and the security exhibit. Two quick asks to keep timeline intact (we're aiming to sign by 12/10):

1) The attached Security Questionnaire (v3) — can you confirm owners and where the artifacts (SOC 2 Type II report, penetration test report, and evidence retention docs) will live? Medivault prefers a secure read-only location.
2) Pen-test window: we need formal language in the MSA/order form about scheduling external testing, point-of-contact, and minimal blast radius (IP ranges, test hours). Are you OK with a 48h advance notice requirement and a mutually agreed 72h window?

Also attaching our list of evidence requests (redline expected). Can your legal team mark whether the audit-rights wording proposed below is acceptable: limited to SOC 2 and mutually agreed third-party pen tests, on-site only with 2 weeks' notice, and non-disruptive?

Appreciate a brief call if that helps.

Best,
Eli Navarro
Director, Information Security
Medivault

Attachment: Medivault_Security_Questionnaire_v3.xlsx

---
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Eli Navarro <eli.navarro@medivault.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA / order form follow-up: SOC 2 artifacts + pen-test access

Eli —

Thanks for the clear asks and the attachment. Short answers and next steps below.

Summary: we can meet your baseline requirements but will propose limited edits to the MSA audit clause to preserve customer data protections and our platform availability guarantees.

Owners & storage:
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent): will be stored in a read-only S3 bucket behind presigned URLs; access requests go to controls@redwood.com. Owner: Laura Bennett (Security Program).
- Pen-test report (third-party): we can provide an executive summary; full report disclosure requires a CDA and redaction of vendor tooling artifacts. Owner: Jonas Weber (Security Ops).
- Evidence runbook (controls mapping): shared Drive link with defined owners per control.

Proposed pen-test scheduling approach (we can align on exact MSA language):
- Redwood requires 48h advance notice and a mutually-scheduled 72h window for external tests.
- Tests must be scoped to customer-owned resources or agreed tenant isolation mechanisms; blackout windows for patching/maintenance to be respected.
- For vendor-led tests, we request vendor contact details and a one-page test plan 72h prior.

MSA redline highlight (quick bullets):
- Audit rights: limited to SOC 2 attestation and mutually-agreed external penetration tests; no on-site full-scope system access without a separate SOW.
- Evidence transfer: presigned secure links; logs retained per contractually-agreed retention period.
- Non-disruption: pen-tests may not execute destructive tests or denial-of-service attacks without express written approval.

I attached an internal draft with suggested MSA edits — Laura and Jonas, please weigh in on any legal/ops constraints we should surface to Medivault.

If Eli wants to hop on a 20-minute call tomorrow or Wed to walk through the questionnaire, I can join.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: proposed-msaredlines-highlighted.docx

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Eli Navarro <eli.navarro@medivault.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA / order form follow-up: SOC 2 artifacts + pen-test access

Eli / Priyom —

I've reviewed the questionnaire and Priyom's proposed edits. A few items of legal redline language to flag so expectations are aligned before we send a formal response:

1) Audit scope carve: we will accept audits limited to scope necessary to validate Redwood's SOC 2 controls as they relate to Medivault's customer data. We cannot agree to broad "systems" access or vendor internal testing that exceeds that scope.

2) Third-party pen tests: agreement to mutually-agreed pen tests is fine provided that:
   - Tests are limited to application-layer and tenant-specific environments; no lateral-movement or infrastructure testing without separate SOW.
   - Test results may be summarized; full vendor reports require a CDA and may be redacted for vendor tooling specifics.

3) Evidence delivery & retention: we will provide a read-only artifact location and periodic extracts for specific controls. We will include a one-time delivery of the last SOC 2 report and a rolling 12-month window of control evidence unless otherwise negotiated.

4) Notice & coordination: 48h notice for scheduling is reasonable; however, for certain deep-scoped tests we may require up to 7 days to coordinate operational windows. We'll flag such cases in the test plan review.

Recommended next step: Priyom — send Medivault a consolidated reply combining the operations notes and the legal redlines. I'll attach the redlined MSA clause text as part of the package. If Medivault's security lead wants to accept these constraints, we can push the order form to DocuSign next week.

Laura Bennett
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redline_audit_clause_snippet.txt (inline in reply)

---
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Eli Navarro <eli.navarro@medivault.com>, Samira Qureshi <samira.qureshi@medivault.com>

Subject: Re: MSA / order form follow-up: SOC 2 artifacts + pen-test access

Eli / Samira —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Attaching our consolidated reply and a short runbook that maps each questionnaire item to the artifact owner and expected delivery timeframe. Highlights below and next steps:

What we will provide:
- SOC 2 Type II (most recent) executive report via secure link within 24 hours of request; full report available under CDA.
- Pen-test: high-level exec summary with remediation commitments; full report under CDA.
- Evidence runbook: link to read-only folder + contact list for each control (owner + backup).

MSA/order form changes we propose (summary):
- Audit rights limited to SOC 2 and mutually agreed pen tests; on-site access only via separate SOW; notice windows: 48h standard, up to 7 days for expanded scopes.
- Non-destructive testing only; no DDoS or destructive payloads without written approval.
- Artifact delivery: presigned URLs, retention as negotiated (default 12 months).

Links / attachments:
- Consolidated reply & runbook (shared link): https://redwood.box.com/s/evidence-runbook
- DocuSign order form (preview): https://docusign.net/preview/abc123
- HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company/contacts/D-2387

Ask: please confirm that the CDA route for full pen-test reports is acceptable to Medivault security. If yes, I'll send the document bundle and DocuSign invite by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks again — happy to jump on a short call if you prefer.

—
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri****@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
